_meta.indication: Treatment of hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in reviewed FDA documents
pivotal_trials.design: Six-week, multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, centrally-rated trial, fixed dose randomized 1:1 (pimavanserin 34 mg vs placebo)
pivotal_trials.population: Patients 40 years of age or older with idiopathic Parkinson's disease (minimum 1 year duration) who developed psychotic symptoms (visual/auditory hallucinations and/or delusions) after PD diagnosis, severe enough to warrant antipsychotic treatment, with a clear sensorium at study entry
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline to Week 6 on the 9-item Schedule for the Assessment of Positive Symptoms in Parkinson's disease (SAPS-PD) scale
pivotal_trials.result: Pimavanserin LS mean change -5.79 vs placebo -2.73; difference from placebo -3.06 (95% CI -4.91, -1.20); p=0.0014

nct_ctgov.title: A Study of the Safety and Efficacy of Pimavanserin in Patients With Parkinson's Disease Psychosis

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥5% and at least twice placebo): peripheral edema (7% vs 2% placebo) and confusional state (6% vs 3% placebo). Serious adverse events including death occurred more often on drug (16/202; 7.9%) than placebo (8/231; 3.5%).
target_moa: Pimavanserin is an atypical antipsychotic that acts primarily as an inverse agonist at serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, lacking prominent dopamine-blocking activity

boxed_warning.content: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs; NUPLAZID is not approved for dementia-related psychosis unrelated to hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis

advisory_committee.vote: The Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee (PDAC) voted 12 to 2 that the benefits of the drug outweighed the risks of treatment (meeting held 29 March 2016)

description.text: Labeling change adding clarifying language about the clinical study patient population; no new indication

summary.text: Pimavanserin, a New Molecular Entity, was granted Breakthrough Status prior to submission and received a Priority Review upon submission. The application was discussed at the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee, which voted 12-2 that the benefits outweigh the risks, and it was approved as a full (non-accelerated) approval based on a single positive Phase 3 trial.
